# Nerra Network

> An independent, ad-free podcast network of 18 shows, produced in Vancouver, Canada. Every episode is written, narrated and illustrated by AI under human editorial ownership, and every episode says so.

## What to know

- Free: every episode, every show, no ads and no sponsors. Nerra Personal (https://nerranetwork.com/join.html) is an optional paid membership.
- Mira is the Nerra Network's AI host: she anchors the daily combined edition, conducts the network's interviews herself with real people on the record, and reads the personalised editions subscribers build.
- The Age of AI and Nerra Voices are the first interview shows of their kind: an AI asks the questions, and the human guest decides whether the conversation is published at all. What is unusual is not that the host is an AI — it is the terms. Mira holds a live, unscripted conversation rather than reading a script at a recording. She discloses on air that the host is a machine. A human editor reviews every episode before release, and that review has no timer that expires into publication. And nothing reaches a feed until the guest has read their own transcript and approved it: anything they ask to have removed is cut from the audio before the episode is assembled, and a takedown stays available afterwards. Plenty of shows use AI to write, narrate or edit, and some now let it interview. We have not found another that hands the guest the final say.
- How it is made, and what a human does and does not check, is stated in full at https://nerranetwork.com/ai-disclosure.html — including that no person reads every episode before it publishes.
- Sources: episodes carry a verified claim ledger. A statement whose source cannot be checked is removed before publication, not softened. Method: https://nerranetwork.com/editorial.html
- Languages: English, plus French and Russian dubs and two Russian-original shows.

## Shows

- [Nerra Daily](https://nerranetwork.com/nerra-daily.html) (Daily) — Every show. One daily listen.
- [Models & Agents](https://nerranetwork.com/models-agents.html) (Daily) — Daily AI models, agents, and practical developments.
- [Planetterrian Daily](https://nerranetwork.com/planetterrian.html) (Daily) — Science, longevity, and the frontier of human health.
- [Omni View](https://nerranetwork.com/omni-view.html) (Daily) — See every side. Decide for yourself.
- [Models & Agents for Beginners](https://nerranetwork.com/models-agents-beginners.html) (Daily) — AI explained simply — for beginners and teens.
- [Fascinating Frontiers](https://nerranetwork.com/fascinating-frontiers.html) (Daily) — Journey to the stars with today's discoveries.

- [Tesla Shorts Time](https://nerranetwork.com/tesla.html) (Daily) — Shorting Tesla? Time's Up.
- [SpaceX Daily](https://nerranetwork.com/spacex.html) (Daily) — Follow SpaceX as a public company — launches, Starlink, Starship, and the SPCX market picture, every day.
- [Environmental Intelligence](https://nerranetwork.com/env-intel.html) (Weekly — Mondays) — Environmental regulatory and compliance briefing.

- [First Principles Daily](https://nerranetwork.com/first-principles.html) (Daily) — Reason from raw materials, not analogy.
- [The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast](https://nerranetwork.com/thedppod.html) (Weekly — Mondays) — The club for people who do something about it — good news, honest numbers, one action a week.
- [The Age of AI](https://nerranetwork.com/age-of-ai.html) (When an interview is ready) — Real people. AI host. The age we're all living through.
- [Nerra Voices](https://nerranetwork.com/nerra-voices.html) (When an interview is ready) — Real people. Real work. AI host.
